result.title: PathPilot: An Adaptive Question-Conditioned Multi-Magnification Navigation Agent for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
result.summary: The diagnostic capability of WSI agents relies on effective slide navigation to identify diagnostically relevant regions and efficiently integrate evidence across the slide. While in clinical practice, pathologists dynamically examine slides across multiple scales, integrating global and cellular evidence in a sequential manner, existing AI navigation approaches mostly operate at a single fixed magnification or rely on predefined magnification traversal. This mismatch prevents existing methods from modeling cross-magnification interactions and adaptive magnification selection inherent to real diagnostic workflows. We propose PathPilot, a clinically consistent multi-magnification WSI navigation agent that explicitly models cross-magnification localization and evidence-adaptive exploration. Specifically, we introduce a CrossMagLoc that learns magnification-specific diagnostic localization from pathologist viewing behavior and integrates information from adjacent magnifications to identify the diagnostically most relevant region within the current ROI, thereby providing a diagnostically informed starting point for subsequent question-conditioned exploration. We further introduce an EviRegionSearch that starts question-conditioned exploration from this region, progressively accumulating question-relevant evidence and adaptively determining the next navigation action according to the remaining evidence requirement. Their iterative interaction enables PathPilot to sequentially explore across ROIs and magnifications until sufficient evidence is acquired. Extensive QA evaluations across five cohorts demonstrate consistent superiority over competing SOTA methods on inter/external cohorts, respectively, validating question-conditioned evidence acquisition across regions and magnifications that mirrors the sequential, knowledge-driven navigation of pathologists.

AI.brief_summary: PathPilot 提出面向全切片图像的多倍率导航 agent：CrossMagLoc 从病理医生观看行为学习倍率相关的诊断定位并融合相邻倍率信息，EviRegionSearch 则以问题为条件逐步累积证据、按剩余证据需求自适应选择下一步动作，直至证据充分，并在五个队列的 QA 上优于同类方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作按证据充分度决定继续观察还是停止、并跨倍率选择观察位置，与 LVR 关注的多尺度视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本直接相关，可供核查其证据累积与停止判据能否迁移到 latent 推理工作区。
